## Details
### **SW-REQ-SD-001** — SD Card Initialization at Startup

- **Description:** The SD library shall initialize the SD card during power-on self-test.
- **Rationale:** FT1 POST must probe the SD card so the operator knows pre-flight whether logging storage is available.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-029
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SD-002** — SD Card Capacity Reporting

- **Description:** The SD library shall report the SD card capacity after successful initialization.
- **Rationale:** PM decision: capacity is observable at POST so the operator can confirm sufficient storage exists pre-flight.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-029
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SD-003** — Run Directory Creation Per Power-On

- **Description:** The SD library shall create a new run directory on each power-on.
- **Rationale:** FT1 requires each power-on to start a fresh log run distinct from prior runs.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-025
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SD-004** — Prior Run Preservation

- **Description:** The SD library shall preserve prior run directories without modification or deletion.
- **Rationale:** PM decision: prior flight data is protected against accidental overwrite between runs.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-055
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SD-005** — Sequential Byte Write Surface

- **Description:** The SD library shall accept sequential byte writes into a file within the current run directory.
- **Rationale:** FT1 mission log writes raw, nav, and event bytes; the SD library provides the write surface.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-022
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SD-006** — Format-Agnostic Byte-Through Writes

- **Description:** The SD library shall write caller-supplied bytes verbatim without modification.
- **Rationale:** PM decision: SD library does not define log format; mlog_lib supplies machine-parseable bytes.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-023
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SD-007** — Sustain Full-Rate Logging Throughput

- **Description:** The SD library shall sustain write throughput sufficient for full-rate FSW sensor and nav logging.
- **Rationale:** FT1 logs sensors at full sample rate plus nav and events; the SD library must keep up without backpressure.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-001
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SD-008** — Continue Writes After Transient Failure

- **Description:** The SD library shall continue attempting writes after a write failure.
- **Rationale:** PM decision: SD failures must not halt mission; the library retries writes on transient errors.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-035
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SD-009** — Write Failure Status Reporting

- **Description:** The SD library shall return a failure status on each write that does not complete successfully.
- **Rationale:** PM decision: SD write failures must be observable so the health state can flag the SD card unhealthy.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-060
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SD-010** — Continuous Health Status

- **Description:** The SD library shall publish a health status reflecting recent write success.
- **Rationale:** PM-required ongoing health observability so the SD bit of the sensor health bitmap stays current.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-031
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SD-011** — POSIX Build Functional Equivalence

- **Description:** The SD library POSIX build shall expose the same write and run-directory behavior as the Pico2 build.
- **Rationale:** PM-required so Trick simulation exercises the same logging paths as flight hardware.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SD-012** — Deterministic Write Behavior

- **Description:** The SD library shall produce identical on-disk bytes given identical inputs.
- **Rationale:** PM-required determinism so Trick sim runs and regression analysis are repeatable.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1
